run_simulation: run a pybullet physics simulation that spawns 1000 spheres in a 3D grid inside a tray
connect_pybullet: connect to pybullet using shared memory or GUI mode for physics visualization
load_urdf_models: load URDF models like planes, trays, and spheres into the pybullet simulation environment
configure_gravity: configure gravity along X, Y, Z axes using interactive debug parameter sliders
set_physics_parameters: set physics engine parameters like solver iterations and contact breaking threshold
